Rule.name: Notify Manager on Privileged Grant
Rule.Description:
Emails an identity's manager when a provisioning request against this application commits successfully. Requires an EmailTemplate named "Privileged Grant Notification" to already exist in IdentityIQ.
result.isCommitted() is the guard that matters most: After Provisioning only fires when the ProvisioningResult is Committed or Queued, but a Queued result is not yet confirmed by the target system, so this rule still checks isCommitted() explicitly rather than trusting "the rule ran at all" as proof of success.
